text: Evidence suggests that the performance of supersets may have a negative impact on markers of recovery. This has been demonstrated both in compound supersets (11) as well as staggered supersets for different body regions (i.e., alternating upper- and lower-body exercises) (89) when compared to performing the same exercises in a traditional fashion. It should be noted that these findings are specific to an isolated bout of training.
